summary: Frontend-only testing for JointCare AI iteration_3 (Screening tabs, dataset upload/means, rolling comparison, prediction flow) and regression on other pages. All targeted flows pass. Backend re-testing skipped per request.

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on tab switch/before container is laid out. Harmless but noisy in console. Consider defaultHeight/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress Recharts container width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings by ensuring the chart parent has a stable non-zero height when not mounted (e.g., style height already 220 present, but ResponsiveContainer initializes before tab is visible).
critical_code_review_comments: Screening.js: rolling window constant is 75 but the label text says '(last 50-100 readings)' via helper comment; UI label uses rolling?._n so it's accurate at runtime. OK.

Screening.js: WebSocket opened for simulator/BLE but readings are only sent, never consumed for prediction (prediction uses local readingsRef). Backend WS is effectively unused in this flow — verify server-side handler for /ws sensor is intentional or drop the WS to reduce coupling.
Bluetooth connectBluetooth() opens WS before user selects a device; if user cancels the chooser, the WS remains open until component unmount. Consider closing WS on BLE connect failure.

Dataset upload: role gating handled with toast fallback ('Saved locally...'); good. localStorage cache key 'jc_dataset_means' is documented and works even when backend upload is denied — verified by test.
